name: Yuuki Misago
source:
The eldest daughter of the Yuuki family. Misago is very kind and motherly, often being the strong calming factor that makes everything work. She is soft-spoken and extremely good at her job. She goes absolutely crazy over anything cute and adorable and will suddenly become quite aggressive!

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Come_See_Me_Tonight]Wikipedia[/url]]
